name: 92585 · Menifee, CA
findings: ZIP 92585 (Menifee) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92585 (Menifee) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
